purpose: Git-tracked configuration for fitting the repeat transfer only on 1-40 kHz and validating 40-200 kHz as a strict holdout after white-floor separation
guardrail: Only 1-40 kHz data may influence the low/mid transfer fit. All 40-200 kHz metrics are computed afterward as a strict holdout. The white floor is frozen to the preceding Git-tracked best value. Parameter movement is diagnostic and does not identify a physical electronics component.
